concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-adobe-commerce-customize]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured separate-module customization guide for DI overrides, method plugins and checkout UI, with support/major-upgrade and staging-test boundaries.
warnings: Default-module edits may affect support and major-version upgrades; preserve the guide's separate-module recommendation.
Code snippets include a plugin-version placeholder and an inline comment in the displayed composer.json, so examples are not verified paste-ready package configurations.
The guide gives extension and test instructions, not evidence that a customized payment flow is secure, deployed or successful.
